+/*
+ * @test
+ * @summary Run the LoopCombinatorLongSignatureTest.java test in CDSAppTester::AOT workflow
+ *          and -Djava.lang.invoke.MethodHandle.COMPILE_THRESHOLD=-1
+ * @bug 8391692
+ * @requires vm.cds.supports.aot.class.linking
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @compile ../../../../../../jdk/java/lang/invoke/LoopCombinatorLongSignatureTest.java
+ * @run driver jdk.test.lib.helpers.ClassFileInstaller -jar app.jar test.java.lang.invoke.LoopCombinatorLongSignatureTest
+ * @run driver LoopCombinatorLongSignatureTest AOT
+ */
+
+import jdk.test.lib.cds.SimpleCDSAppTester;
+import jdk.test.lib.process.OutputAnalyzer;
+
+public class LoopCombinatorLongSignatureTest {
+    public static void main(String args[]) throws Exception {
+        SimpleCDSAppTester.of("HelloAOTCache")
+            .addVmArgs("-Djava.lang.invoke.MethodHandle.COMPILE_THRESHOLD=-1")
+            .classpath("app.jar")
+            .appCommandLine("test.java.lang.invoke.LoopCombinatorLongSignatureTest")
+            .runAOTWorkflow();
+    }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+This directory contains wrappers for using the AOT workflow to execute
+a subset of the tests  ../../../../../../jdk/java/lang/invoke.
+
+Note that the name of the wrapper is the same as the original test. E.g.,
+
+- the wrapper: ./BigArityTest.java
+- original test: ../../../../../../jdk/java/lang/invoke/BigArityTest.java
+
+However, the wrapper class is in the default package, whereas the original test
+is in the test.java.lang.invoke package.
+
+Some of the wrappers are auto-generated by CDSMHTest_generate.sh. Other wrappers
+are hand written.
